product: Native XML file format support is now generally available
tagline: Native XML file format support is now generally available.
what_it_does: Native XML file format support is now generally available. You can ingest, query, and parse XML files in batch or streaming workloads with Auto Loader, read files, and COPY INTO, and use the from xml and schema of xml SQL functions. Extensible Markup Language (XML) is a markup language for formatting, storing, and sharing data in textual format.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
